incidents.name: MO Loan borrow/redeem double accounting
incidents.notes: The MO Loan contract let the same collateral back a new borrow after redeem() returned it, so an 80-iteration borrow/redeem loop against one small MO position drew out the entire MO/USDT pair balance, which was then sold for USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: Loan 0xAe7b6514Af26BcB2332FEA53B8Dd57bc13A7838E created 2024-03-11T06:33:05Z by 0x9747fa1bfab2690562406d150f173e3c4a2d5aa6, not the attack-tx sender 0x4e2c6096985e0b2825d06c16f1c8cdc559c1d6f8; no EIP-1967 events, 2.9 days old. The PoC loops borrow(mo_balance,0) then redeem(i) until it reverts, confirming the position is reusable. PoC header reports ~413K USD profit.
